title: Composed seam remainders force an impossible congruence or fractional-part combination after the cycle exponents cancel
statement: After multiplying or composing the exact remainder cells p^2 <= v^3 < (p+1)^2 and q^2 <= p < (q+1)^2 around a cycle, the residual inequalities (once the main 3^o versus 2^L powers cancel) require an impossible combination of congruences or fractional parts that is not global_defect_identity / image_eq_start_defectRatio / cycle_remainder_balance / cycle_not_localsTight / peak_diophantine_slack / cycle-scale R_nec first-letter parity / remainder-finance unrestricted cell position / cycleMin_finance / leftover near-convergents of log 2 / log 3.
counterexamples: composed seams on 365 OOE recover global_defect_identity: Delta = envelope slack, not a new residual
on a cycle the leftover is n^{3^o}-n^{2^L} (image_eq_start_defectRatio); L=19 has gap 7153 and L=84 has gap 3^{53}-2^{84}; both are finance gaps, not moduli
cyclic remainder balance is an identity: Sigma rho + even gaps - odd gaps = start^2 - end^2, and vanishes on a return
peak pair at 13 is envelope slack 13^3 - 6^4 = 2*10*46^2 + 10^2 + 81
first-step OOE remainders on [13,400) occupy several residues mod 3,8,9,16, not one forbidden class
at n >= 10^6+1 every listed modulus has 2Y+1 > m, so defects are free residues (cycle_mod_closure)
notes: Phase 0 only. Reviewer reserve attack 7 (floor-defect / congruence accumulation). The residual after exponent cancellation is a REPARAMETERIZATION of the global defect; its size is finance; congruences and fractional parts were already closed. No finance leftover-killer, no floor raise, no new modulus census, no Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: seam cells at 13; composed residual on 365 OOE; peak-pair slack at 13; path balance on 365 OOE; first-step residues on OOE starts in [13,400); defect-width collapse on the archived moduli at n=10^6+1; near-top witness 1016445; leftover gaps at L=19 and L=84
